# Umalator worker

Unmodified Global worker by alpha123, licensed under GNU GPL v3 (see LICENSE).

Worker blob: bdc6869a91fd6facf5733b41465d536f15cc07de.
Source and build instructions: https://github.com/alpha123/uma-tools/tree/dfbeafb23253b238a0417ddd4dde70a36fd11d4f
The source uses the uma-skill-tools submodule; initialize it recursively as recorded by that revision.
Game data belongs to Cygames. The adjacent worker is loaded only when a race comparison is requested.

data/race-skills.json contains that build's Global skill data, purchase groups and course geometry.
These files are pinned together; update them together and validate before changing this snapshot.
